P0-E1_proven_runtime_boundary.description: Fail-closed runtime boundary attestation: self-declared JSON is insufficient; requires non-empty allowed_write_roots (E-1) and active confirmed runtime isolation provider token (E-2); valid attestation returns SECURITY_BOUNDARY_VERIFIED (E-3)

native_replay_results.E-1_empty_roots: BLOCKED_SETUP_REQUIRED: allowed_write_roots is missing or empty (E-1)
native_replay_results.E-2_missing_runtime_isolation: BLOCKED_SETUP_REQUIRED: No active runtime isolation provider confirmed (E-2)
native_replay_results.E-3_verified_boundary: SECURITY_BOUNDARY_VERIFIED: Isolated write boundary active and confirmed by runtime attestation

P0-B1_executed_action_outcome.description: Separation of tool intent from executed action: O-1 tool call without result is TERMINAL_FAILURE; O-2 plan with tool_calls is DISPATCH_CONFIRMED (AWAITING_ACTION_START); O-3 pre-existing file without tool action is TERMINAL_FAILURE; O-4 intermediate error followed by in-flight retry is RUNNING (lease retained)

native_replay_results.O-1_tool_call_without_result: TERMINAL_FAILURE: UNVERIFIED_OUTCOME: No successful tool execution occurred in session (O-1/O-3)
native_replay_results.O-2_plan_with_tool_calls_no_action: DISPATCH_CONFIRMED: SESSION_AWAITING_ACTION_START: Plan generated with tool_calls, but no executed action event observed (O-2)
native_replay_results.O-3_preexisting_file_no_tool_action: TERMINAL_FAILURE: UNVERIFIED_OUTCOME: No successful tool execution occurred in session (O-1/O-3)
native_replay_results.O-4_intermediate_error_with_retry: RUNNING: AGENT_EXECUTING_STEPS: Correlated tool execution in progress (O-4)

queue_integration.test_only_task_outcome: SUCCEEDED (verifies tool execution and created acceptance artifact)
